learning_outcomes.text: After successful completion, the student has acquired knowledge in the elective subjects taken, according to the respective descriptions. The content must not significantly overlap with the study program of the respective Master's degree program.

assessment_rules: The examination performance depends on the chosen elective subjects and according to the corresponding study and examination regulations of the offering study program. The selection of subjects must be approved by the Dean of Studies. At least 3 ECTS must be completed in technical subjects. A grade is awarded for the module, therefore a grade must be awarded for at least one study achievement (if several are completed for this module); if several graded study achievements are completed for this module, the grades are weighted according to the ECTS.
institution: Hochschule Karlsruhe - Technik Und Wirtschaft — Maschinenbau (M.Sc.)
